dedupe_keys.name: arptc market observatory reports quarterly mobile telephony and internet market statistics dr congo

description: The Autorité de Régulation de la Poste et des Télécommunications du Congo (ARPTC), the telecom and postal regulator of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, publishes market observatory reports on its website. The mobile telephony observatory lists quarterly reports from the second quarter of 2023 to the first quarter of 2026; the internet observatory has reports on the mobile and fixed internet market for 2021-2022 and for each half of 2023; the trend reports (Rapport annuel Tendance) cover the years 2003 to 2017; and monthly call centre reports (for example April and May 2026) summarise consumer complaints. There is also a postal observatory and an annual report page. Coverage is national; resolution is per operator and per quarter or year. Format and access: PDF reports linked from the observatory pages; no tables, bulk files or API were seen. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: figures must be extracted from PDFs, there is a gap in the trend series after 2017 before the quarterly series starts, and the annual report page was empty when read. Simulation uses: subscriber, traffic and operator market data for telecom capacity and resilience analysis in Central Africa. Related records: comparable to the AGER São Tomé telecom statistical indicators and the ECTEL Eastern Caribbean sector review.
